nodes.rationale: Runner initializes torch.distributed with NCCL even single-process; Windows PyTorch lacks NCCL, so use WSL2/Linux

nodes.label: Selected weight memory budget
nodes.source_file: LongCat Video Avatar 1.5 Workstation Feasibility Tutorial.md
nodes.notes: INT8 DiT 15.88 GB; distilled LoRA 2.52 GB; Whisper 3.09 GB; text encoder+VAE 23.23 GB; total ~41.65 GiB; BF16 DiT 31.7 GB excluded
nodes.rationale: 48 GB card plausible but unproven; INT8 chosen for headroom
